headlines.title: Trump administration cancels some Canada tariffs amid close midterm races
headlines.description: Sen. Susan Collins, who’s in a tough re-election fight, said she secured from the Trump administration tariff exemptions on some agricultural and forestry items.

headlines.title: DOJ sues to block Alaska Senate certification if GOP’s Dan Sullivan loses
headlines.description: The Justice Department is suing Alaska election officials to prevent them from certifying Senate race results if GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan loses next month.

headlines.title: DOJ charges two former top FBI officials who were frequent targets of Trump allies
headlines.description: Two former FBI officials who have come under withering criticism from allies of President Donald Trump over their intelligence work during the 2020 presidential election have been charged with allegedly lying to Congress.

headlines.title: Ramaswamy says ad featuring Acton’s mother had nothing to do with allegations of sexual abuse
headlines.description: Ohio Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy is defending the ad featuring his opponent Amy Acton’s estranged mother despite backlash from both parties. NBC News’ Priscilla Thompson explains.

headlines.title: DOJ launches new midterm legal battle
headlines.description: President Trump directed the DOJ to sue to block the results of the Alaska Senate race if Republican Dan Sullivan loses. Republicans said another man with the same name has jumped into the race to confuse voters. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: First Lady Melania Trump secures ceasefire for Ukrainian city
headlines.description: All sides are praising Melania Trump for securing a ceasefire for a war-torn Ukrainian city on the front lines to allow people there to evacuate. NBC News’ Chief Foreign Correspondent Richard Engel reports.

headlines.title: Trump hopes to flatter Putin into negotiating on Ukraine
headlines.description: A Trump diplomat called Putin “a humanitarian,” another in a recent flurry of overtures to the Russian leader. But it’s unclear whether blandishments will entice him to strike a deal.

headlines.title: Drive to Decision Day: Voters sound off on the economy, war and Washington
headlines.description: With the midterm elections almost here, NBC News’ Jonathan Allen wanted to find out if Americans are frustrated enough with President Trump and Republicans to vote Democrats into power in the House and Senate. So he hopped in a van and drove 1,800 miles from New Jersey to Nebraska to meet with voters in eight battleground districts.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.
